records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings.EmbeddingsScreen.closeEvent#1
records.source: The crop stop flag is set first and further DINO progress is ignored. Each ``shutdown`` waits a bounded time, then parks any worker that outlasts it. A parked training worker can finish writing its checkpoint without updating this closed screen; it is not forcibly terminated.
records.context: The extracted image region stop flag is set first and further DINO progress is ignored. Each ``shutdown`` waits a bounded time, then parks any worker that outlasts it. A parked training worker can finish writing its checkpoint without updating this closed screen; it is not forcibly terminated.
records.translation: 先设置图像裁剪区域的停止标志，并忽略后续 DINO 进度。每次 ``shutdown`` 都只等待有限的时间，随后将仍在运行的工作线程交由后台托管。托管中的训练线程可以完成检查点写入，而不更新这个已关闭的界面；不会强制终止该线程。
